messages:
rachel: quick flag  onboarding helios13b-int8 showed a reproducible drop on codegen function-call accuracy when quantized with our int8 backend. native fp16 baseline returns well-formed JSON calls, int8 run returns malformed arg order and missing keys.
liam: can you paste an example prompt + fp16 vs int8 outputs?
rachel: prompt: "Write a python function that returns a JSON with keys 'name', 'version', 'deps' given a package spec. Use function-call format."
fp16 (expected function call): {
  "name": "fastparse",
  "version": "1.3.0",
  "deps": ["libc>=2.29", "serde"]
}
int8 (observed): {
  "version": "1.3.0",
  "deps": ["libc>=2.29"],
  "name": "fastparse"  
}
notes: order mismatch plus deps truncated on some runs.
anil: that smells like projection-order/permute bug in our kernel mapping for QKV when using blockwise int8 packing. we've seen head-reshuffle bugs when head_dim is not a multiple of blocksize and compiler fallback reorders the per-head layout. helios uses atypical head_dim=64 with 13 heads (weird), so packer adds a pad and our permute step may have used the wrong stride.
liam: i ran a quick diff across outputs using the eval harness. commands:
```
python eval_harness.py --model helios13b-fp16 --task codegen_functioncall --prompts small_pkg.json --out /tmp/helios_fp16
python eval_harness.py --model helios13b-int8 --quant int8_blockpack --task codegen_functioncall --prompts small_pkg.json --out /tmp/helios_int8
```
summary metrics:
- fp16: function-call exact match 0.92, arg_presence 0.97, avg_tokens 46
- int8: function-call exact match 0.68, arg_presence 0.85, avg_tokens 38
also ran headwise perplexity per-token; int8 shows spike after token 12 consistently.
rachel: interesting that avg_tokens drop. might be early termination from token logits instability. anil: can you dump the QKV weight shapes and the packer stride for helios-int8?
anil: shapes from conversion artifact: qkv_weight shape (3, 13, 64, 4096) after splitting -> when we blockpack into 32-byte lanes we pad head_dim from 64->96 for the packer (uh) and the reorder map used index_stride=96 instead of 64 in the attention kernel. patch is ready in my branch that fixes stride->head_dim for odd-pad case. i'll push unit test.
liam: before we merge, can we run a quick controlled experiment: 1) int8 with corrected packer, 2) int8 with fallback layout (no blockpack), 3) int8 with per-head transpose enforced?
rachel: i kicked off 3 jobs on dedicated (small ci): job ids hbt-101/102/103. will post results.
eval-bot: job hbt-101 (int8 corrected-packer) finished: exact_match 0.90, arg_presence 0.96, avg_tokens 45.
eval-bot: job hbt-102 (int8 no-blockpack) finished: exact_match 0.91, arg_presence 0.97, avg_tokens 46.
eval-bot: job hbt-103 (int8 enforce-transpose) finished: exact_match 0.89, arg_presence 0.95, avg_tokens 44.
liam: awesome, corrected-packer + fallback both recover most of the regression which points to packer reorder bug as root cause. fallback slightly better for exact match but slower.
anil: i'll open a PR to make packer respect head_dim stride and add a conversion-time assert to ensure no reordering for non-divisible head counts. also adding a conversion test that runs a tiny function-call prompt through fp16/int8 roundtrip.
triage-bot: created ticket INF-9901: "helios13b-int8: blockwise int8 packer stride bug causing function-call arg/order regressions" (assignee: anil, priority: P1).
rachel: rolling helios13b-int8 canary back for hosted until PR is in and we validate. thanks all for fast turnaround. please link PR here when ready. :rocket:
